description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Renekton''' cleaves around himself, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies and [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healing]] himself for each enemy hit, up to a cap.
description.text: Active: Renekton cleaves around himself, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies and healing himself for each enemy hit, up to a cap.

description2.raw: Against [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]], the healing is increased.
description2.text: Against champions, the healing is increased.

description3.raw: '''Renekton''' generates [[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|2.5 Fury]] for each non-champion hit and 10 Fury for each champion hit, up to 30 total per cast.
description3.text: Renekton generates 2.5 Fury for each non-champion hit and 10 Fury for each champion hit, up to 30 total per cast.

description4.raw: '''[[File:Renekton Reign of Anger.png|20xpx|border|link=Renekton#Reign of Anger|An icon for Renekton's ability Reign of Anger]] [[Renekton#Reign of Anger|Reign of Anger]] Bonus:''' ''Cull the Meek'' has increased damage, tripled '''total''' healing, and a quadrupled healing cap.
description4.text: Reign of Anger Bonus: Cull the Meek has increased damage, tripled total healing, and a quadrupled healing cap.

description5.raw: '''''Renekton''' cannot basic attack nor cast [[File:Renekton Slice and Dice.png|20xpx|border|link=Renekton#Slice and Dice|An icon for Renekton's ability Slice and Dice]] [[Renekton#Slice and Dice|Slice and Dice]] or [[File:Renekton Dominus.png|20xpx|border|link=Renekton#Dominus|An icon for Renekton's ability Dominus]] [[Renekton#Dominus|Dominus]] for 0.25 seconds after Cull the Meek's activation.''
description5.text: Renekton cannot basic attack nor cast Slice and Dice or Dominus for 0.25 seconds after Cull the Meek's activation.
